notes: Estimates are focused project days, not calendar days.
The baseline assumes approximately one focused project day per week.
Target dates are planning aids, not commitments.
Maturity indicates the overall engineering state expected after a step; it is not a substitute for step exit evidence.
Documentation milestones show when existing/future engineering documents are expected to become concrete, reviewable or authoritative.
Re-estimate a step when implementation evidence materially changes uncertainty.
